items.title: A revisit of remote Spectre attacks on Cloudflare Workers
items.summary: In 2024 and 2025, we reassessed remote Spectre attacks on our Workers infrastructure. We share details about the new attack primitives like Spectre gadgets, remote timers, achieving co-location and how new defenses further harden Cloudflare Workers.

items.title: BGP Role model: tracking the adoption of RFC 9234
items.summary: RFC 9234 lets routers reject route leaks on their own, using BGP Roles and the Only to Customer attribute. We measured who has deployed it, and found two Tier 1 networks unexpectedly stripping OTC.

items.title: How Cloudflare detects MCP traffic and helps secure it
items.summary: Cloudflare Gateway identifies MCP requests using protocol-level heuristics. Security teams can use that signal to find shadow MCP traffic, enforce Portal-only access for approved servers, and block direct connections on managed network paths.

items.title: Secure all your internal vibe-coded applications — in one click
items.summary: Introducing Cloudflare Access for Workers. Attach an Access policy directly to a Worker and it applies everywhere that Worker runs — routes, custom domains, workers.dev, and previews — automatically.

items.title: Total eclipse of the Internet: traffic impacts in Iceland, Spain, and Portugal
items.summary: Cloudflare's data shows a clear impact on Internet traffic from Iceland to Spain and Portugal, following the path of totality of the total solar eclipse that occurred on August 12, 2026.

items.title: Certificate Transparency Monitoring is now generally available
items.summary: Cloudflare's Certificate Transparency Monitoring is now generally available. The biggest change: we no longer email you about certificates Cloudflare issued for your domain, so when an alert lands in your inbox, it's worth a look.

items.title: Signal Taps Cloudflare to Help Protect the Privacy of Hundreds of Millions of Users Through Key Transparency
items.summary: Cloudflare is helping Signal’s users worldwide gain extra confidence that their conversations are private and secure

items.title: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report H1 2026: 1 Tbps attacks soar as DNS floods and geopolitical tensions drive a new wave
items.summary: In the first half of 2026, Cloudflare detected a 519% surge in hyper-volumetric DDos attacks across its network. These attacks were driven heavily by DNS and CLDAP reflection vectors. This report breaks down how major geopolitical conflicts reshaped the global cyber threat landscape.

items.title: Cloudflare, Inc. Announces Pricing of Offering of $2.175 Billion of 0% Convertible Senior Notes Due 2031
items.summary: Cloudflare, Inc. Announces Pricing of Offering of $2.175 Billion of 0% Convertible Senior Notes Due 2031

items.title: Cloudflare Achieves FedRAMP High Authorization to Secure and Accelerate the U.S. Government’s Critical Missions
items.summary: Cloudflare also announces GovRAMP Moderate and intent to pursue Impact Level 4 (IL4) authorization to protect the nation's sensitive data across the Federal government, DoD, and highly-regulated industries.

items.title: Everything we launched during Agents Week
items.summary: Our latest Agents Week has come to a close. Here’s a recap of all the announcements we made, from Wallets to Radar.

items.title: Serving the most critical missions: Cloudflare for Government achieves FedRAMP Class D (High) Certified status
items.summary: Cloudflare for Government achieves FedRAMP Class D (High) Certified status. We also announce our commitment to pursue DoD IL4 authorization. Cloudflare brings world-class security, performance, and developer products to the public sector.

items.title: Cloudflare, Inc. Announces Proposed Private Offering of $2.175 Billion of Convertible Senior Notes Due 2031
items.summary: Cloudflare, Inc. Announces Proposed Private Offering of $2.175 Billion of Convertible Senior Notes Due 2031

items.title: Unveiling good and bad behaviors on the Agentic Internet
items.summary: Cloudflare is shifting bot mitigation from point-in-time Risk assessment to continuous Trust evaluation. Learn how new good and bad behaviors from bots and agents are assessed by our systems, including BotBase and Precursor — and try out our Precursor Trace simulation to see how your own cursor movements would be assessed as human or bot.

items.title: Unifying Workers AI and AI Gateway into a single AI control plane
items.summary: Cloudflare is unifying AI Gateway and Workers AI into a single control plane, giving developers observability, billing, and dynamic routing across both managed GPUs and external providers. Learn how unified bindings and model-first routing simplify building resilient AI applications.

items.title: Announcing Cloudflare Ambassadors, Community Engineers, and another $1M in open-source funding
items.summary: We are launching updated community programs, including Cloudflare Ambassadors and Community Engineers, backed by $1M in open-source funding. Learn how we are supporting maintainers and scaling our developer community.

items.title: Introducing Radar Researcher: An AI tool for exploring Internet data in plain language
items.summary: Cloudflare Radar Researcher is a new AI-powered tool that lets you explore global Internet trends and traffic data using plain language. Built entirely on Cloudflare's Developer Platform, it turns natural language queries into real, interactive charts.

items.title: The next generation of MCP
items.summary: The next version of MCP has a rewritten, stateless core that just works on Workers. We cover upgrades to the protocol, the new feature lifecycle and SDK migration path, and hear from early adopters already running it in production.

items.title: From ranking to recommended: get your site ready to thrive in the age of AI agents
items.summary: More than half of requests now come from machines, not people. Agent Readiness shows how well agents can discover and read your site, while Answer Engine Optimization tracks how often AI assistants recommend you.

items.title: Cloudflare AI Search: give your agents a search engine for your data
items.summary: AI Search makes search easier than ever, with no Cloudflare primitives to stitch together. Point it at your data to create a search for your own files and websites. We're also sharing a preview of our new pricing model.

items.title: Give any website a WebMCP interface
items.summary: Today we're launching a developer preview of WebMCP on Cloudflare. With one switch, any site becomes usable by browser AI agents — no new APIs, no origin changes — while the human stays in control and creators keep their traffic.

items.title: Building an open Agentic Internet: readable, discoverable, callable, and payable
items.summary: Agents are a new kind of visitor. They don't render CSS or click ads, but they have a paying human on the other end. Block them and you block your customer. We're building the open tools and protocols so publishers and agents can cooperate and not collide.

items.title: Introducing Kitesurf: The agent-first browser that runs in V8 isolates on Cloudflare Workers
items.summary: We should be giving all agents tools that excel at what’s important for an AI model. Kitesurf is Cloudflare’s new stateless, highly scalable, and cost-effective web browser that runs entirely on top of Workers and was designed specifically for the Agentic Cloud.

items.title: Cloudflare Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Cloudflare Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results

items.title: Cloudflare Adds AEO Visibility Dashboard to Its AEO Suite, Showing Brands Whether AI Assistants Are Recommending Them
items.summary: New AEO Visibility Dashboard gives brand marketers a clear view of how AI assistants are citing, mentioning, and ranking them

items.title: Cloudflare is the only vendor named a Visionary in 2026 SASE and SSE reports
items.summary: We're honored to announce that Cloudflare is the only vendor that has been recognized as a Visionary in both the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SASE Platforms and the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Security Service Edge reports.

items.title: The Agent Access Model
items.summary: The Agent Access Model proposes a new architecture to secure task-scoped agents using strict identity brokering, continuous mediation, and stateful trust.

items.title: How we’re rethinking work at Cloudflare with Cloudflare OS
items.summary: We built Cloudflare OS to equip our teams to safely rethink how they get work done with AI. The platform brings together the best of our technologies, from our Compute primitives to our Zero Trust suite. This post walks through our journey to give our users the best AI tools available.

items.title: Catching rogue AI behavior with identity-aware analytics
items.summary: Identity-aware AI Gateway is now in open beta. User Insights turns that traffic into a behavioral baseline for every person and agent, and flags insider risk the moment it appears.

items.title: Cloudflare OS: an open platform for agents, apps, and work
items.summary: Cloudflare OS is an open-source platform that lets everyone in your company build apps, automate work, and safely access internal systems, shaped around what your organization knows and how it operates.

items.title: WriteGuard: fine-grained controls for MCP Servers
items.summary: At Cloudflare, we knew we could not depend on every employee to configure every agent perfectly or watch every tool call. Before expanding write access across our own internal MCP servers, we built WriteGuard. We are now bringing those controls to Cloudflare MCP server portals through a private beta.

items.title: Cloudflare OS Is the First AI Workspace Built Around How Companies Actually Work
items.summary: New open source agent workspace gives employees AI tools built around how their company operates, with security and governance built in by default

items.title: Cloudflare Gives Companies Full Visibility to Audit & Analyze AI Use
items.summary: New tools shows companies exactly which employees and agents are using AI, what they're sending, and how much it's costing—in real time, securely and without slowing down innovation

items.title: Introducing: Cloudflare Agents
items.summary: Cloudflare Agents brings all of your deployed agent sessions into a single experience, surfacing key information and insights into how your agents perform at scale.

items.title: Your agent can now debug Workers with local tracing
items.summary: wrangler dev now produces structured traces for every local request. Your coding agent can hit a single API to pinpoint exactly what failed and why — no deployment required.

items.title: How we built a software factory to drive Astro’s GitHub issue count to zero
items.summary: By replacing manual issue verification with isolated AI subagents running in GitHub Actions, the Astro maintainers reduced open issue count by 85%. This post explores the architecture behind automated bug reproduction, patch verification, and preview releases.

items.title: Announcing Cloudflare Wallets: the programmable wallet for the agentic Internet
items.summary: Cloudflare Wallets will provide AI agents with native payments and verifiable identity on the web. Using the x402 protocol, agents can autonomously purchase APIs and content within clear safety guardrails.

items.title: How Cloudflare enforces engineering standards using AI
items.summary: We created the Cloudflare Codex, a governed body of engineering standards that AI agents consume across the development lifecycle. By pairing structured RFCs with agentic reviews, teams automatically enforce consistency across code, specs, and incident reports.

items.title: Run CI/CD for millions of repos — on your platform, on Cloudflare
items.summary: Run CI/CD for millions of repos — on your platform, on Cloudflare

items.title: The Agent Development Lifecycle has arrived on Cloudflare
items.summary: Agents can write code faster than teams can review, deploy, and maintain it. Today we’re introducing the Agent Development Lifecycle and the Cloudflare primitives that underpin it.

items.title: Cloudflare Gives AI Agents an Identity and a Wallet
items.summary: New tools mean businesses will be able to see who's behind an AI agent, and those agents will be able to pay for things safely on their owner's behalf.

items.title: Your agent needs a computer, not a container — introducing @cloudflare/computer
items.summary: Agents need more than just a container to scale. We're introducing @cloudflare/computer, an agent runtime that dynamically orchestrates between fast, efficient isolates and full Linux containers to give every agent a computer of its own.

items.title: Workers RPC now works across Python and JavaScript
items.summary: One coding agent can write a Python Worker and another can write a JavaScript Worker. At runtime, those Workers can exchange references to live objects and call their methods without defining APIs, schemas, or serialization code.

items.title: Cloudflare Workers and Containers now support inbound TCP connections and gRPC
items.summary: Cloudflare Workers now support inbound TCP connections via Spectrum, allowing direct socket forwarding to Durable Objects and Containers. Developers can run full-duplex gRPC applications or leverage automatic gRPC-to-gRPC-web translation directly within Workers.

items.title: Introducing the Billable Usage API: programmatic cost visibility for Cloudflare
items.summary: Cloudflare has launched a new Billable Usage API for accounts, giving developers and FinOps teams single-endpoint programmatic visibility into cost and usage across all self-serve products. Built around the FOCUS specification, spend can now be tracked seamlessly alongside the rest of your cloud stack.

items.title: Smaller, faster, safer: running Kimi and GLM at scale
items.summary: Serving frontier models like Kimi and GLM means fighting for GPU memory. Here's how we quantize KV caches, compress model weights, and add integrity checks to serve them faster, cheaper, and safely.

items.title: Welcome to Agents Week
items.summary: Agents Week explores how cloud infrastructure must evolve to serve autonomous agents rather than human browsers. Join us as we unpack the storage, execution, and security primitives needed for an agent-native web.

items.title: An API for MoQ: provision your own isolated relays
items.summary: Last year we made every Cloudflare server a Media over QUIC (MoQ) relay. Now the new provisioning API lets you create your own isolated relay and control who can publish and who can only watch.

items.title: Dogfooding at scale: migrating cdnjs to Cloudflare’s Developer Platform
items.summary: We moved cdnjs, serving 9 billion requests a day, entirely onto Cloudflare's Developer Platform. That means we’re running one of the Internet's busiest open-source CDNs on our own building blocks, and we pushed Workflows and Workers limits higher for everyone.

items.title: Post-quantum authentication to origins is now supported
items.summary: Cloudflare now supports post-quantum (PQ) authentication when connecting to customer origin servers via Authenticated Origin Pulls and Custom Origin Trust Store. This is the first step towards providing PQ authentication for all Cloudflare products.
